map.示例：用 Mermaid 语法画一张判断流程图: Example: draw a decision flowchart with Mermaid syntax
map.：输入：\ngraph TD\n A[开始] --> B{条件判断}\n B:
: Input:
<graph TD
  A[Start] --> B{Condition?}
  B -->|Yes| C[Process]

The page renders in real time (500ms debounce); after confirming, click 'Export SVG / PNG' to get vector or bitmap.
